name: item_pebble_b
description: a throwable pebble (survival item; the tutorial teaches throwing one at the ranger): a broken rock chip seen from straight above, variant b of 3 (a squat chip / b taller wedge / c wide slab with a knob); the glint sits on its crest. Use any variant; pick at random.

glint.note: draw over the item; show only while the item is lit (frame 0 = #bab4aa plus over the crest, frame 1 = empty)

held_note: in the hand / in flight the pebble is the girl's pebble_held (a 2 x 2 #8d817b, ws03 throw)
